user_story: As a user, I want to be able to open a new window when I click on the 'Click Here' link so that I can access additional content without losing my current page. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click on the link with text 'Click Here', a new window should open. 2. The URL of the new window should not be the same as the original page. 3. The original page should still be accessible after the new window is opened.
